title: OmniCode MCP server preset
description: One presets/<id>.json per upstream MCP server. Mirrors PresetSchema in packages/shared/src/schemas.ts; validated in CI by scripts/validate-presets.mjs (design 16.7).

id.description: Must equal the file name without .json.

transport.description: A hint only; the Hub follows what it detects (streamable_http is also tried for legacy sse servers).

url.description: https only. The hostname must be a public DNS name: no IP literals, no localhost, no dot-less names (design 16.2). Shown in full to the user before the server is added.

headerName.description: For type=header: the header the user's key is sent in (the key itself is entered in the UI and stored in Secrets Manager).

scopes.description: For type=oauth: scopes to request when the server's metadata does not say.

docs.description: https link to the server's documentation; shown next to the URL.

defaultAgents.description: Agents pre-selected in the add dialog.
